content_zh:
第520章过的很幸福
陈楚晚上正睡着，实际上只是搂着马小翠。
虽然马小翠这段时间被折腾得很惨，但毕竟二十六七岁年纪正是结实的，而且常年在地里劳作，身体也不虚，恢复了一阵又能行了。
不过陈楚这次像疼爱自己老婆一样，力度不是很重，又进行了一回。
正这时候，听见外面吵吵闹闹的。
陈楚精神力量一扫，就发现外面一片火光，发现是着火了。
随后推断了一下，就知道是赵三这小子无意中点燃了赵小偷家的房子。
村民们起来喊着救火。
马小翠也醒了，本身就勤快，手脚麻利，躺不住，连忙问：“外面是咋回事啊？”
陈楚搂着她的小蛮腰，在她的小嘴巴上亲了一口：“老婆啊，没事，是赵小扣他家着火了，我感觉他们家三口人都出来了，没事，不用管他。”
“哎呀，那不行啊，都是邻居，得去忙乎忙乎。”
马小翠刚要掀开被子下炕，忽然发现他不挂一丝，这才急忙抓来衣服裤子，脸上一片害羞，忘了自己是和陈楚光屁股一被窝的。
几下穿好，麻溜的往外跑。
陈楚也穿好衣服跟了出去。
只见赵小扣他家火势已经很大了，周围村民见陈楚和马小翠来了，好奇的问：“陈楚啊，你咋跟马小翠走在一块呢？”
随后又看见在另一边的赵三。
赵三忙开始装逼，说：“陈楚那方面比较虚，所以特意来找我，听说我特别猛，问我有啥偏方没，我就把偏方告诉陈楚了。”
“哦，原来是这么回事啊。”
村民点了点头，发现赵三这两天的确挺猖獗，有的村民也小声地问赵三偏方。
陈楚也不管他，他既然又要装逼，就让他装个够吧，反正自己得到实际上的实惠了。

这时候有人给赵小扣出主意：“快点打电话啊，救火啊！”
赵小扣这才反应过来：“对对对，儿子，快点给消防队打电话！”
大儿子掏出电话，转头问他爹：“爹，119多少号来着？”
赵小黑愣了三秒钟，随后狠狠一脚踢在儿子腿上：“你这个王八蛋，你说119多少号，赶紧给老子打！”
“哦，明白了。”
赵大柱把电话拨了出去，那边接通：“喂？嗯，你那边有啥事？”
赵大柱急切地说：“我家着火了，你们赶紧来了吧，好了，挂了。”
说完便挂了电话。
剩下村民一脸茫然。
赵小扣琢磨几下，咂了咂嘴，又狠狠踢了儿子一脚：“你他妈告诉咱家在哪了吗？”
赵大柱挠了挠头：“没说啊。”
“那咱家着火了，他是消防队的，他能不知道咱家在哪吗？”
“你他妈的！”
赵小扣都要气死了：“他消防队也不是诸葛亮，他能掐会算吗？你不说他知道咱家在哪？”
赵大柱气咻咻道：“爹，你这么说话我就不乐意了，消防队是干啥吃的，咱家着火了，他为啥能不知道呢？”
“你他妈的！”
赵小扣这时候跳了起来，一巴掌抽在儿子的脖子上，本来他想抽脸的，只是没够着：“赶紧再给老子打电话，别挂断！”
好了，赵大柱还是一脸的委屈，拨通电话：“喂，你好。”
赵大柱刚说一句，又挨了他爹一脚：“你他妈还挺客气啊，赶紧说着火了！”
“哦，我家着火了。”

那边问：“你家在哪啊？你叫啥名？”
赵大柱咽了口唾沫，说：“我叫赵大柱，我爹叫赵小抠。”

Chapter 520 Lived very happily
Chen Chu was sleeping at night, actually just holding Ma Xiaocui in his arms.
Although Ma Xiaocui suffered a lot during this period, she was still strong at the age of 26 or 7, and she had been working in the fields all year round, so her body was not weak, and she was able to function again after recovering for a while.
However, this time Chen Chu acted like he loved his wife, and the intensity was not very strong, so he did it again.
At this time, I heard some noise outside.
As soon as Chen Chu's mental power swept away, he noticed a fire outside and found that it was on fire.
After some extrapolation, we found out that it was Zhao San who accidentally set fire to Thief Zhao's house.
The villagers got up and shouted to put out the fire.
Ma Xiaocui also woke up. She was diligent and quick with her hands and feet. She couldn't lie down and asked quickly: "What's going on outside?"
Chen Chu put his arms around her waist and kissed her on the small mouth: "Honey, it's okay. It's Zhao Xiaokou whose house is on fire. I think all three of his family are out. It's okay. Don't worry about him."
"Oh, that won't work. We are all neighbors and have to go and be busy."
Just as Ma Xiaocui was about to lift the quilt and get off the bed, she suddenly realized that he was naked. Then she hurriedly grabbed her clothes and pants, with a look of embarrassment on her face, forgetting that she was sharing the same bed with Chen Chu's naked buttocks.
After putting it on for a few times, I ran out smoothly.
Chen Chu also got dressed and followed him out.
I saw that the fire in Zhao Xiaokou's house was already very strong. Seeing Chen Chu and Ma Xiaocui coming, the surrounding villagers asked curiously: "Chen Chu, why are you walking with Ma Xiaocui?"
Then he saw Zhao San on the other side.
Zhao San started to show off and said, "Chen Chu is weak in that area, so he came to see me specially. He heard that I was very strong, so he asked me if I had any folk remedies, so I told Chen Chu the folk remedies."
"Oh, that's what happened."
The villagers nodded and found that Zhao San had indeed been quite rampant in the past two days. Some villagers also asked Zhao San in a low voice for his home remedies.
Chen Chu didn't care about him. Since he wanted to show off again, let him pretend enough. Anyway, he would get actual benefits.
At this time, someone gave Zhao Xiaokuan an idea: "Hurry up and call us to put out the fire!"
Only then did Zhao Xiaokou react: "Yes, yes, yes, son, call the fire brigade quickly!"
The eldest son took out the phone and turned to his father: "Dad, what is the number 119?"
Zhao Xiaohei was stunned for three seconds, and then kicked his son hard in the leg: "You bastard, what number did you say is 119? Hurry up and hit me!"
"Oh, got it."
Zhao Dazhu dialed the phone and answered the call: "Hello? Well, what do you want over there?"
Zhao Dazhu said eagerly: "My house is on fire. Come here quickly. Okay, hang up."
After saying that, he hung up the phone.
The remaining villagers looked confused.
Zhao Xiaokou thought for a few times, smacked his lips, and kicked his son hard: "Did you fucking tell us where our home is?"
Zhao Dazhu scratched his head: "I didn't say anything."
"Then our house is on fire. He is from the fire brigade. How can he not know where our house is?"
"Fuck you!"
Zhao Xiaokou was furious: "He in the fire brigade is not Zhuge Liang, can he count? You don't say he knows where our home is?"
Zhao Dazhu said angrily: "Dad, I don't like it when you talk like that. What does the fire brigade do? Our house is on fire. Why doesn't he know?"
"Fuck you!"
Zhao Xiaokou jumped up at this time and slapped his son on the neck. He originally wanted to slap his face, but he couldn't reach it: "Hurry up and call me again. Don't hang up!"
Well, Zhao Dazhu still looked aggrieved and dialed the phone: "Hello, hello."
As soon as Zhao Dazhu said something, he was kicked by his father again: "You are so damn polite, hurry up and get angry!"
"Oh, my house is on fire."
The other side asked: "Where is your home? What is your name?"
Zhao Dazhu swallowed his saliva and said, "My name is Zhao Dazhu, and my father's name is Zhao Dazhu."Little dig. "
